map.卡方计算器是一款科学研究领域的在线工具。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准: Compute the chi-square statistic and degrees of freedom from observed and expected frequencies, with a significance hint for independence tests.
map.观察频数 O（逗号分隔，每行一类目）: Observed frequencies O (comma-separated, one category per line)
map.期望频数 E（与 O 等长；留空则等概率）: Expected frequencies E (same length as O; leave blank for equal probabilities)
map.卡方统计量度量观测频数 O 与期望频数 E 的偏离程度；df 由表格维度决定（拟: The chi-square statistic measures the deviation of observed frequencies O from expected frequencies E; df is determined by the table dimensions (goodness-of-fit df=k-1, independence test df=(r-1)(c-1)), then look up the chi-square distribution for the p-value.
map.检验观察频数与期望频数是否一致（拟合优度）、检验两个分类变量是否独立（独立性检验: Test whether observed and expected frequencies agree (goodness-of-fit), and whether two categorical variables are independent (independence test).
map.若 p < 0.05，拒绝原假设（即观察与期望有显著差异）。: If p < 0.05, reject the null hypothesis (i.e. a significant difference exists between observed and expected).
map.类别型变量的拟合优度/独立性检验。: Goodness-of-fit / independence tests for categorical variables.
map.遗传学中检验观测分离比是否符合孟德尔理论比例。: In genetics, test whether the observed segregation ratio matches the Mendelian theoretical ratio.
map.观测 [30,10]、期望 [25,15]：χ²=(30-25)²/25+(10: Observed [30,10], expected [25,15]: χ²=(30-25)²/25+(10-15)²/15=1+1.667=2.667, df=1, compare with the table for significance.
map.过小会使卡方近似失真，需合并或 Fisher 检验。: Too small values distort the chi-square approximation; merge categories or use Fisher's exact test.
map.自由度怎么定？: How is the degree of freedom determined?
map.拟合优度检验 df=类别数−1；独立性检验 df=(行数−1)×(列数−1)。: For goodness-of-fit df = number of categories - 1; for independence test df = (rows - 1) × (columns - 1).
